label: Academic Search
title: Academic Search
subtitle: Searches Semantic Scholar's database of over 200 million academic papers. Agents can find papers by topic, look up author publication lists, and retrieve citation counts and abstracts.
whenToUse: Use when conducting a literature review, fact-checking a scientific claim, building a bibliography, or exploring what research exists in a given field.

methods.name: Search Papers
methods.description: Searches for papers matching a keyword query. Returns titles, authors, year, citation count, and abstract.

methods.name: Get Paper Details
methods.description: Returns full metadata for a specific paper by Semantic Scholar ID or DOI — including references and citations.

methods.name: Search Authors
methods.description: Finds author profiles matching a name query. Returns author ID, name, affiliation, and citation metrics.

methods.name: Get Author Publications
methods.description: Returns the full publication list for a given author ID, sorted by citation count.

mediaCaption: An academic search result card listing paper titles, authors, year, citation counts, and truncated abstracts
tips: Use Get Paper Details after finding a paper to retrieve its full reference list, then chain into further searches.
